question: How many patients are in the database?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count FROM patients;

question: List patients who have a diagnosis of hypertension.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.patient_id, p.name FROM patients p JOIN diagnoses d ON p.patient_id = d.patient_id WHERE d.diagnosis_name ILIKE '%hypertension%' OR d.icd10_code = 'I10';
